## 3. The Cortes-Castro pin — HONEST NEGATIVE, with a correction proposal (user-owned)

The project attributes the pLOH+aneuploidy HRD classifier cut-offs to
"Cortes-Castro et al., Cancer Research 2020"
(`R/hrd-reference.R:62-64`, which carries its own
`TODO(paper): pin the exact bibliographic record`). This session's
searches, on a working network:

- Crossref author query `Cortes-Castro` (15 most-relevant works): **no
  Cancer Research 2020 HRD paper**; no HRD paper at all.
- Crossref bibliographic queries (HRD genomic scars; telomeric LOH +
  aneuploidy): no matching first-author work.
- **PubMed esearch `Cortes-Castro[Author] AND 2020[dp]`: count = 0** —
  the author has no 2020 PubMed record at all.
- Steele et al. 2022's 24-author list contains **no Cortés-Castro**.

Verdict: the attribution as committed is **unverifiable in both major
bibliographic databases**. The evidence points to **Steele et al.
2022 (Nature 606:984-991, §2 above)** as the true anchor for the
pLOH/aneuploidy scores (the paper the reference implementation itself
cites). Correcting this touches committed provenance claims
(`R/hrd-reference.R`, `tests/testthat/helper-hrd.R`,
`paper/devlog-2026-11-17-r8-independent-hrd-reference.qmd`,
`paper/paper-draft.qmd:346`) — that is a **user-owned ruling**, not a
silent edit; the proposal is recorded here and surfaced in the session
report. Until ruled, the manuscript must not cite "Cortes-Castro et
al., Cancer Research 2020".

## 4. The 0.80–0.90 band citation pin — candidate named; one false pin refuted

`R/hrd-reference.R` (and the m7 memo's match-tolerance decision) ask
for the external source ref of the frozen 0.80–0.90 match band
(midpoint 0.85 = `MATCH_MIN_COSINE`). This session:

- **Refuted candidate**: mmsig (`evenrus/mmsig`) — my remembered
  "0.85 threshold" is FALSE; its `cos_sim_threshold` default is
  **0.01** (R/fit_signatures.R:29) with removal semantics, not match
  semantics. Do not cite mmsig for the band.
- **Named candidate, not yet pinned**: Degasperi et al., "A practical
  guide and benchmarks for mutation signature extraction" — NOT
  retrievable on this session's Crossref index under the tried title
  forms; the anchor must be pinned from the paper PDF at submission
  time. Until then the band cites the project's own frozen protocol
  fact (benchmark memo 2026-10-05 §3), which is what the memo already
  says it is ("a protocol fact, not a tuned value").
